source.title: Mokena D159 School Calendar 26.27.pdf
source.verification: The district's March 19, 2026 announcement states that the Board approved the 2026-2027 school-year calendar and links this PDF. The public Google Drive viewer rendered the approved one-page calendar as an image; this fixture is a manual transcription of its labels, color legend, and date markers.
source.transcription_policy: Preserve the published calendar categories. Do not infer dismissal times from color markers. Keep school-specific attendance exceptions distinct from district-wide closures.

reconciliation_notes: The approved calendar confirms August 17-18 as Teacher Institute Days and August 19 as the first day of school.
The approved calendar legend counts four Teacher Institute Days: August 17-18, October 9, and January 4.
The approved calendar legend counts nine School Improvement/Early Dismissal Days: September 4, October 30, November 20, December 18, January 15, February 12, March 12, April 16, and May 28.
The approved calendar explicitly identifies the school-specific e-learning arrangement for November 3 and April 6: MES and MIS in session; MJHS e-learning.

Early-dismissal times are not printed in the approved calendar image. September 4 school-specific times are supported by the attached district live-feed graphic and the 'tomorrow is our first Early Dismissal Day' post, cross-checked against the calendar's September 4 marker; see the live-feed supplement. Do not infer times for October 30.
Emergency days June 1-4 and June 7, 2027 are contingency days and must not be treated as scheduled school days unless activated.

May 31, 2027 Memorial Day / school holiday is present in this approved-calendar transcription (source text: “School Holiday - Offices Closed”) but has no matching VEVENT in the archived district iCalendar export captured 2026-11-03. Keep it as an approved-calendar-sourced event; do not fabricate an iCalendar source record or treat the feed omission as cancellation.
